coordinator_sheet_notes: Clean and friendly: slicked hair with two tufts, a huge showman grin, a candy-stripe jacket, a bow tie and a vintage broadcast mic on a cane. Keep it clearly non-demonic. For the Rat Casino's dim lighting, add a subtle warm rim or brass highlights so he reads at a distance. Attack: sweeping mic-cane swing with a showy bow; defeat: bows too far and plops down, still grinning, held.
coordinator_model_notes_revised: Updated after Tom's September 26 ruling (DESIGN-027): scary is welcome, no gore. At the model stage push him creepier: a too-wide grin with sharp teeth, eyes that glow red in the dark (emissive), a faint static halo. Attack: a mic-cane swing with a radio-static burst. Defeat: a jerky, glitchy bow, frozen mid-grin, held.
sheet_vs_model_note: The sheet was painted and approved before the DESIGN-027 ruling, so it shows the friendly, never-scary showman its notes describe. The revised model notes supersede the sheet's friendliness only; the silhouette, costume, colours, proportions and sheet pose carry over to the model.
ruling: Tom, September 26: Claude Opus 5.5 does the remaining WO111 Blender work; assets without an Astra concept follow a painted Blender reference sheet that the coordinator reviewed (PRD-004 Q-07). Tom, September 26 (DESIGN-027): genuinely scary is welcome where the era fits, with no gore.
